products.name: TREBLAB U5 Hybrid ANC Over-Ear Headphones (Focus One), IPX4, 55-hour battery
specs: Hybrid ANC, up to 30 dB (maker claim)
Up to 55 h with ANC off, about 40 h with ANC on (maker claim); one reviewer got close to 50 h with mixed use
products.warranty: 1-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects (TREBLAB store terms)
products.returns: 30-day free returns in original packaging; free US shipping on orders over $49
products.summary: Over-ear headphones with noise cancelling that carry an IPX4 sweat rating and a long claimed battery life. TREBLAB also sells replacement pads for them.
products.fit: Gym-goers who sweat and want over-ear noise cancelling without risking expensive headphones.
caveats: IPX4 covers sweat and splashes only. Wipe them down after a workout and don't rinse them.
One reviewer found the touch controls can trigger by accident when you adjust the headphones mid-workout.
The noise cancelling cuts steady noise like treadmills and fans but still lets voices through. There's no app to adjust it.
The headband wires are exposed and could snag (The Gadgeteer).
Like any over-ear model, they can slide during bench presses, burpees and running.
